newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks lower in early morning.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks lower in early morning.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were lower in early morning trade on Friday, as the market was still vulnerable after the key stock index plunged more than 700 points at one stage the previous day. But brokers said the speed of the fall could be slower as the index posted a sharp rebound in late Thursday trade.

The Nikkei 225 average was down 96.13 points or 0.50 percent at 19,195.45 in the first 10 minutes of trading. On Thursday, it briefly fell as low as 18,819.92, its lowest level since December 1, 1995.
Its March futures lost 50 points to 19,220.
